headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.38
summary: Synced upstream: the options editor and external mods screens were refreshed, the splash screen now hands off on the first frame instead of playing a long animation, and the update screen is translated in every bundled language. Plus one small secret in the home header.

items.text: The options editor and the external mods screen picked up upstream's refresh: a shared toolbar layout, a cleaner property list and mod rows that show the author again.
The splash screen no longer plays a long intro animation. It now draws one frame and moves straight to the launcher, so starting the app feels quicker on slow devices.
The update screen, release notes and download flow are now translated for every bundled language instead of falling back to English.
There is a small easter egg in the home header: tap the Minecraft title or its Bedrock Edition line seven times.
